description: CLSC v1 LedgerStore catalog checkpoints: structured catalogs, the cut each reflects, the file name the cut gives, and the exact bytes they encode to; decoding the bytes yields the catalog and the cut. A catalog holds its next handle, its live replicas in handle order, each with the window K its creating request recorded, and its tombstones, the dropped ledgers in ascending order. Cut files and offsets, first files, and ledger IDs are decimal strings.

cases.name: empty
cases.description: A new store's first checkpoint: the empty catalog at the WAL's first durable frontier, next handle 0.

cases.name: one-replica
cases.description: One replica of ledger 1 at handle 0, created by a request of window 64, whose create record lies in WAL file 1.

cases.name: replicas-and-tombstones
cases.description: Replicas at handles 1, 3, and 4 below next handle 5, in handle order, of ledgers 2, 9, and 5, each of window 4; the replicas at handles 0 and 2, of ledgers 6 and 11, were dropped, so their tombstones remain.

cases.name: dropped-only
cases.description: Three handles assigned and every replica dropped: next handle 3, no replica, and the tombstones of ledgers 1, 2, and 3.

cases.name: tombstones-of-unheld-ledgers
cases.description: No handle assigned, and the tombstones of ledgers 4 and 8, which the node dropped without ever holding them.

cases.name: maximum-handle-and-ledger
cases.description: Every handle assigned, next handle 2^24 - 1, the first replica of the smallest window, 1, the last replica handle 2^24 - 2 with the largest window, 2^31 - 1, first file, and ledger ID, the tombstone of ledger 2^64 - 2, at the largest cut.
